insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (non-resetting): 10% every renewal irrespective of claims (up to 100%)
great.quote: “On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.”
great.explanation: Your Sum Insured can increase by 10% each year even if you make a claim, up to a maximum of 100% of base SI—this is better than typical NCBs that reduce/reset after claims.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (standard)
good.quote: “30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illness claims are not covered in the first 30 days (accidents covered). This is standard in health insurance.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months (standard)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.”
good.explanation: Certain listed conditions/surgeries have a 2-year waiting period, which is industry standard.

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months (good as per rules)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 3 continuous years. As per your rules, 36 months is still acceptable (not a red flag).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: up to 60 days
good.quote: “Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital”
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 60 days before hospitalization—standard.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: up to 90 days
good.quote: “Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation”
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 90 days after discharge—standard.
